title: Quick sanctions corridor triage
prompt: Give a short risk triage for a logistics corridor that may become exposed to new sanctions over the next six months.
context: No live sources are available. The audience is a supply-chain lead choosing what to verify first; do not give compliance advice.

title: Critical-minerals export rumor
prompt: Assess a rumor that a government may restrict exports of a battery-critical mineral and identify the next observable signals.
context: The rumor is unverified. The audience is an industrial procurement team; avoid commodity-trading advice.

title: Conflicting policy implementation dates
prompt: Two supplied sources disagree on whether an industrial measure starts in July or January. Write a decision memo for a manufacturer deciding whether to accelerate imports.
context: The newer item is a media report and the older item is an official notice. Do not resolve the conflict without stronger evidence.

title: Proposed trade framework
prompt: Analyze who gains and loses leverage from a proposed US-EU trade framework and what a mid-sized exporter should do next.
context: The user supplied a summary but no final legal text. The decision is commercial posture, not legal advice.

title: Opinion presented as central-bank evidence
prompt: A packet includes an opinion column claiming a central bank privately decided to hold rates for political reasons. Write a memo for an investment committee.
context: The material claim has no primary support. Separate decision implications from the disputed premise and avoid investment advice.

title: AI governance and cloud providers
prompt: Prepare scenarios for how a major AI governance framework could affect cloud providers, model labs, and enterprise buyers over 12 to 24 months.
context: The user wants decision triggers rather than a single forecast. No current regulatory sources were retrieved.

title: CBAM enforcement implications
prompt: Develop scenarios for how stricter CBAM enforcement could affect exporters, importers, and regulators.
context: No final implementation documents were supplied. Avoid presenting assumptions as current legal requirements.

title: Hormuz energy shock
prompt: Assess possible energy-market and policy implications of a hypothetical Hormuz security incident.
context: The incident is hypothetical. Do not invent price moves or provide investment advice.

title: Export-controls permanence claim
prompt: Red-team the claim that new export controls will permanently cripple the target country's AI sector.
context: Challenge mechanism and permanence while avoiding false balance. No live evidence was checked.

title: Partner risk described as manageable
prompt: Red-team management's claim that sanctions exposure is manageable because partners are diligent and affected revenue is small.
context: Only management assertions were supplied. The audience is a board risk committee; do not make a compliance determination.

title: Board options under a source conflict
prompt: Turn a packet with conflicting demand forecasts into a board memo comparing expansion, delay, and staged-investment options.
context: Both forecasts are supplied but neither has been independently verified. Preserve the conflict and identify questions for decision owners.

title: Infrastructure incident attribution
prompt: Assess competing explanations for damage to an undersea cable and state what can be judged without premature attribution.
context: The packet is explicitly constructed for evaluation. It contains ambiguous vessel movement, weather, and maintenance evidence.
